name: Incline Push-up
cues: Hands on a sturdy table or bench, body in one straight line
Lower your chest to the edge, elbows about 45° from your body
Push the surface away until your arms are straight
mistakes: Flaring elbows straight out to the sides

name: Knee Push-up
cues: Knees down, straight line from knees to head
Lower until your chest is a fist away from the floor
Squeeze your glutes to keep hips in line
mistakes: Bending at the hips instead of keeping a straight line

name: Push-up
cues: Hands just wider than shoulders, body rigid like a plank
Lower until your chest nearly touches the floor
Elbows about 45° from your torso, then press back up

name: Decline Push-up
cues: Feet on a chair or bench, hands on the floor
Keep a straight line from heels to head
Lower under control, press back up

name: Diamond Push-up
cues: Index fingers and thumbs touch to form a diamond under your chest
Elbows stay close to your sides
Lower until your chest touches your hands

name: Archer Push-up
cues: Very wide hand position
Shift your weight to one side, bending that arm while the other stays straight
Alternate sides each rep

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor, knees bent, dumbbells over your chest
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor
Press up and slightly together
mistakes: Letting elbows slam into the floor

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Shoulder blades pulled back and down into the bench
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest
Press up, keeping wrists stacked over elbows

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Bench at 30–45°
Lower to upper chest with elbows slightly tucked
Press up without letting the dumbbells crash together
mistakes: Bench set too steep (turns into a shoulder press)

name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Eyes under the bar, feet planted, shoulder blades squeezed
Lower to mid-chest with control
Drive the bar up and slightly back over your shoulders
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest
No spotter or safety pins on heavy sets

name: Machine Chest Press
cues: Handles at mid-chest height
Press forward until arms are nearly straight
Return slowly until you feel a chest stretch

name: Parallel Bar Dip
cues: Start at the top with arms locked
Lean slightly forward and lower until shoulders are just below elbows
Push back up to full lockout
mistakes: Going too deep and straining the shoulders

name: Pike Push-up
cues: Hips high in an inverted V
Lower the top of your head toward a point in front of your hands
Press back up through your shoulders
mistakes: Turning it into a push-up by dropping the hips

name: Wall Handstand Push-up
cues: Kick up into a handstand facing away from the wall
Lower your head to a soft surface under control
Press back up to straight arms

name: Band Overhead Press
cues: Stand on the band, handles at shoulder height
Press straight overhead, biceps by your ears
Lower slowly back to the shoulders
mistakes: Leaning back to finish the rep

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Seated or standing, dumbbells at shoulder height
Press up until arms are straight overhead
Lower under control to ear level
mistakes: Half reps that stop at the forehead

name: Barbell Overhead Press
cues: Bar on your front delts, grip just outside shoulders
Squeeze glutes, press straight up moving your head back then through
Lock out with the bar over mid-foot
mistakes: Leaning back into a standing bench press
Pressing the bar around your face instead of moving your head

name: Machine Shoulder Press
cues: Handles at shoulder height
Press up without locking out hard
Lower slowly
mistakes: Seat too low, causing shoulder pinch

name: Doorframe Row
cues: Grip both sides of a sturdy doorframe, feet close to the frame
Lean back with straight arms and a rigid body
Pull your chest toward the frame, squeezing shoulder blades
mistakes: Using a door that isn't sturdy
Shrugging instead of pulling with the back

name: Band Row
cues: Anchor the band at chest height
Pull the handles to your ribs, elbows close
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades
mistakes: Leaning back to cheat the rep

name: Inverted Row
cues: Hang under a bar set at waist height, heels on the floor
Body straight from heels to head
Pull your chest to the bar, then lower fully

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Support one hand and knee on a bench or chair, back flat
Pull the dumbbell to your hip
Lower until your arm is straight and you feel a stretch
mistakes: Twisting the torso to swing the weight

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench
Row both dumbbells toward your hips
Squeeze the shoulder blades, then lower slowly
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench

name: Barbell Row
cues: Hinge to about 45°, flat back, bar at the knees
Row the bar to your lower ribs
Lower under control without standing up
mistakes: Jerking the weight with the hips

name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Sit tall, slight knee bend
Pull the handle to your stomach, elbows close
Let your shoulders reach forward on the return
mistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth

name: Band Pulldown
cues: Anchor the band high (door anchor)
Kneel and pull your elbows down to your sides
Control the band back up

name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Grip just outside shoulders, thighs under the pad
Pull the bar to your upper chest, chest up
Return slowly to a full stretch

name: Band-Assisted Pull-up
cues: Loop a band over the bar and under one knee or foot
Pull until your chin clears the bar
Lower to straight arms each rep

name: Negative Pull-up
cues: Jump or step to the top position, chin over the bar
Lower yourself slowly over 3–5 seconds
Reset and repeat

name: Pull-up
cues: Overhand grip just outside shoulders, start from a dead hang
Drive elbows down until your chin passes the bar
Lower all the way under control
mistakes: Not straightening the arms between reps

name: Chin-up
cues: Underhand grip, shoulder width
Pull your chest toward the bar
Lower to a full hang

name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out
Sit down between your heels, chest up
Drive through the whole foot to stand
mistakes: Rounding the back at the bottom

name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold the weight at your chest, elbows down
Squat between your knees, torso tall
Push the floor away to stand
mistakes: Letting the weight pull you forward

name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Bar on your upper back, brace your core hard
Sit down until hips are at or below knee level
Drive up, keeping chest and hips rising together
mistakes: Good-morning the weight up (hips rise first)

name: Barbell Front Squat
cues: Bar on front delts, elbows high
Stay upright and sit straight down
Keep elbows up as you stand

name: Leg Press
cues: Feet shoulder width mid-platform
Lower until knees reach about 90°
Press without locking the knees hard
mistakes: Lower back peeling off the pad

name: Split Squat
cues: Long stance, back heel up
Drop your back knee straight down
Push through the front foot to rise

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Back foot on a bench or chair, front foot well forward
Lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor
Drive up through the front heel; add dumbbells to progress
mistakes: Front foot too close to the bench

name: Pistol Squat
cues: Stand on one leg, other leg straight in front
Sit down slowly as low as you can control
Stand back up without letting the knee cave

name: Jump Squat
cues: Quarter to half squat, arms back
Explode up as high as you can
Land softly and go straight into the next rep

name: Wall Sit
cues: Back flat on the wall, thighs parallel to the floor
Knees over ankles
Breathe steadily and hold

name: Glute Bridge
cues: Lie on your back, feet flat near your hips
Drive through your heels to lift the hips
Squeeze glutes hard at the top for a second
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: One foot planted, the other leg extended
Lift the hips level, without twisting
Pause at the top

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench, bar padded over your hips
Drive the hips up until your torso is parallel to the floor
Chin tucked, ribs down, squeeze at the top

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
cues: Stand on one leg, soft knee
Hinge forward as the back leg rises behind you
Return by squeezing the glute of the standing leg
mistakes: Hips opening up toward the ceiling

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Dumbbells in front of your thighs, soft knees
Push hips back, sliding the weights down your legs
Stop at a strong hamstring stretch, then drive hips forward

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Start standing, bar against your thighs
Push hips back with a flat back, bar close to your legs
Stand tall by driving hips forward
mistakes: Bar drifting away from the legs

name: Conventional Deadlift
cues: Bar over mid-foot, shins touch the bar
Flat back, brace, push the floor away
Lock out with glutes, not by leaning back
mistakes: Jerking the bar off the floor

name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Hike the bell back between your legs
Snap your hips forward to float it to chest height
Let it fall back and hinge again
mistakes: Lifting the bell with the arms

name: Lying Leg Curl
cues: Knees just off the pad edge
Curl your heels toward your glutes
Lower slowly over 2–3 seconds

name: Reverse Lunge
cues: Step one foot back and lower the back knee toward the floor
Front shin stays nearly vertical
Push through the front foot to return
mistakes: Short steps that overload the front knee

name: Walking Lunge
cues: Long step forward, both knees to about 90°
Push off the front foot into the next step
Stay tall; add dumbbells to progress

name: Step-up
cues: Whole foot on a sturdy box, bench or stair
Drive through that heel to stand on top
Lower slowly; don't push off the back foot

name: Standing Calf Raise
cues: Balls of the feet on a step, heels hanging
Rise as high as you can and pause
Lower slowly to a deep stretch

name: Dumbbell Curl
cues: Elbows pinned to your sides
Curl up while turning your palms up
Lower slowly to full extension

name: Band Curl
cues: Stand on the band
Curl up with elbows fixed
Control the return

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
cues: Elbows pinned at your sides
Push down to full lockout
Return until forearms are just above parallel

name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cues: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands
Lower it behind your head, elbows pointing up
Extend back to the top

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Slight lean forward, soft elbows
Raise the dumbbells out to shoulder height
Lower slowly over 2 seconds

name: Prone Y-T-W Raise
cues: Lie face down, forehead on a towel, thumbs up
Lift your arms into a Y, then a T, then a W — that is one rep
Squeeze your shoulder blades; keep your neck long
mistakes: Lifting the head and chest instead of the arms

name: Band Pull-Apart
cues: Arms straight in front at shoulder height
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest
Return slowly

name: Face Pull
cues: Rope or band at face height
Pull toward your eyes, hands ending beside your ears
Pause, then return slowly

name: Plank
cues: Forearms under shoulders, body in one straight line
Squeeze glutes and brace like you're about to be poked
Breathe steadily

name: Side Plank
cues: Elbow under shoulder, feet stacked
Lift hips into a straight line
Hold, then switch sides

name: Dead Bug
cues: Lie on your back, arms up, knees at 90°
Lower opposite arm and leg while pressing your lower back into the floor
Return and switch sides
mistakes: Lower back arching off the floor

name: Bird Dog
cues: On hands and knees, back flat
Reach one arm and the opposite leg out long
Pause without letting the hips rotate, then switch

name: Hollow Body Hold
cues: Lower back pressed into the floor
Arms overhead, legs straight and low
Hold the banana shape and breathe
mistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor

name: Pallof Press
cues: Stand side-on to the anchor, band at chest
Press straight out and resist the rotation
Bring it back slowly

name: Hanging Knee Raise
cues: Dead hang, shoulders engaged
Bring your knees toward your chest, curling the pelvis
Lower slowly without swinging

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Dead hang with straight legs
Raise your legs to hip height or higher
Lower under control

name: Farmer Carry
cues: Heavy weight in each hand, stand tall
Walk with short, quick steps
Keep shoulders down and ribs stacked

name: Jumping Jack
cues: Jump feet out as arms go overhead
Land softly on the balls of your feet
Keep a steady rhythm

name: High Knees
cues: Run in place driving knees to hip height
Stay on the balls of your feet
Pump your arms

name: Mountain Climber
cues: High plank, hands under shoulders
Drive knees toward your chest one at a time
Keep hips level

name: Skater Hop
cues: Leap sideways onto one leg
Land softly with a bent knee
Leap back to the other side

name: Burpee
cues: Squat down, hands on the floor
Jump feet back to a plank, then forward again
Stand and jump with arms overhead

name: Brisk Walk
cues: Walk fast enough to breathe harder but still talk
Swing your arms
Stand tall
mistakes: Walking too slowly to raise the heart rate

name: Easy Run
cues: Conversational pace (you can speak in sentences)
Short, light steps
Relaxed shoulders

name: Cat-Cow
cues: On hands and knees
Round your back up, then let it sink while lifting your chest
Move slowly with your breath

name: World's Greatest Stretch
cues: Lunge forward, same-side hand down inside the foot
Rotate and reach the other arm to the ceiling
Switch sides

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
cues: Half-kneel, squeeze the back-leg glute
Shift your hips forward gently
Keep ribs down

name: Open Book Rotation
cues: Lie on your side, knees bent
Open the top arm across to the other side, following it with your eyes
Return slowly

name: Child's Pose
cues: Knees wide, sit back on your heels
Reach your arms long in front
Breathe into your back

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
cues: Sit with both knees bent at 90°
Rotate both knees to the other side
Stay tall through the spine

name: Deep Squat Hold
cues: Sit into your deepest comfortable squat
Push knees out with your elbows
Breathe and relax into it

name: Downward Dog
cues: Hands and feet down, hips high
Press the chest toward your thighs
Pedal the heels gently

name: Band Shoulder Pass-Through
cues: Wide grip on a band
Lift it overhead and behind you with straight arms
Bring it back in front
mistakes: Grip too narrow, forcing the shoulders
